what-s-with-the-firing-tatus.text:
This snooze button should remain white, actually, I think, just for consistency we should put these confirm buttons into a small footer inside of the card. The buttons can be white, but smaller than they are now, inside of a footer and right justified. You still have these weird labels like "Timer snooze".. Those take up an unnecessary amount of vertical space. You should just make it look like a call-out where there's some kind of icon followed by a bolded subtitle e.g. "**Recommended snooze** — ..." 

I hate the fact that we have this outer agent card with an inner agent card/tool call component inside it. It looks terrible. I don't understand why we have an agent fence at all.
